thread:
Leila: Heads-up — planning a staged regional cutover for the routing fallback feature. Need agreement on canary sizes, telemetry gates, flag names, customer opt-in flows, and emergency rollback steps. TL;DR checklist below.

Sanju: +1. Can we lock the initial hold size? Thinking 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m evaluation windows.

Leila: That cadence looks good. Proposed automatic hold conditions: p95 latency delta > 20% OR 5xx increase > 0.5pp OR customer error spike on opt-in tenants. Also quality gate: model eval score drop > 2% on the golden prompt set.

Morgan: For private deployments, add KMS rotation and key-check step pre-cutover. Also confirm we don't expose rollout flags in the control plane logs.

Ops (oncall): We'll need a regional maintenance window for the first 10% step in eu-west-1 — capacity bump + pre-warm GPUs. Also require a documented kill-switch with runbook link.

Sanju: Proposed feature flag naming: `prod.rollout.routing.fallback.v1` (boolean), and per-tenant opt-in flag `tenant.<tenant-id>.routing.fallback.optin`. Keep rollout config in repo: `infra/flags/routing_fallback.json`.

Leila: Love the naming. Add an annotation field `owner`, `launch_ticket`, and `signal_contacts` in the flag metadata.

ops-bot: Canary schedule created: start=2023-11-01T18:00Z; steps=[0.5%,2%,10%,25%,100%]; auto-hold=true. See /deploy link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/1234

Ops (oncall): Runbook checklist (short):
- Verify capacity pools in target region
- Confirm KV cache warmup job runs (cmd: `./scripts/warmup.sh --region eu-west-1`)
- Validate monitoring dashboards are populated for cohort metrics
- Ensure rollback tag exists and tested

Sanju: A/B note: if we do a side-by-side quality test for variant B (quantized model), start with 5% traffic split for B inside the 10% stage, measure relevance/latency for 24h.

Morgan: Security check: no raw prompts logged for opt-in tenants; confirm encryption-at-rest + egress rules. I'll review the infra PR.

Leila: Launch gating KPIs (all must be green to proceed):
- Telemetry: p95 latency within 20% of baseline, 5xx delta <0.5pp, token throughput matches capacity plan
- Quality: eval-suite pass rate >= baseline -2% and no systemic hallucination regression on safety set
- Cost: cost/token estimate within X% of projected budget for initial month

Sanju: If a gate trips, auto-fallback should route to previous model variant and notify #incidents and owners. We should also capture 1k sample requests for postmortem.

Leila: Owners: @Sanju (eng), @Morgan (security), @Ops (oncall). Please ack with :white_check_mark: and I'll kick off the shiproom doc and customer opt-in email draft.

Morgan: :white_check_mark: I'll vet the KMS steps this afternoon.

Sanju: :white_check_mark: I'll add flag metadata and open the infra PR.

Ops (oncall): :white_check_mark: I'll schedule the maintenance window and sanity test slot.

Leila: Great — I'll create the Launch Issue with checklist and ping customer success for early-adopter outreach. Thanks everyone.

Sanju: Quick follow-up: who owns the per-tenant opt-out audit logs? We should add that to the runbook.

Leila: Good call — assigning to @ProductCompliance in the launch issue.

ops-bot: reminder: preflight smoke run scheduled 2023-11-01T16:00Z.
